g.text: GEMM 1 read row p // top_k, write row p
SiLU x mul read row p, write row p
GEMM 2 read row p, write row p, x topk_weights[p]
moe_sum add rows t x top_k ... t x top_k + top_k - 1
Two places change the row order:
with p // top_k on the read side.
with the sum over top_k rows.
so each block uses one expert's
